production.note: US model years from 2025, still on sale (Ford.com offers the "2026 Ford Mustang® GTD", source ford-us-mustang-gtd-2026). MotorTrend's test covers the "2025 Ford Mustang GTD"; Autoweek's February 2025 report gives the weight of production cars (source autoweek-gtd-weight-2025).

body.note: Fixed-roof fastback coupe only; no convertible is offered.

displacementL.note: Ford states "5.2L". 5,163 cc: Car and Driver's panel prints "Displacement: 315 in3, 5163 cm3" (cd-mustang-gtd-2025).

drivetrain.note: Ford describes a "carbon‑fiber driveshaft" to a "rear‑mounted 8‑speed transaxle"; rear-wheel drive is inferred from that description.

transmission.note: "Paired with an eight‑speed dual‑clutch for instant shifts." Rear-mounted transaxle; MotorTrend: "Tremec dual-clutch transaxle" (source motortrend-gtd-test-2026).

powerHp.note: Quote, Ford.com: "Experience the adrenaline-fueled thrill of 815 HP & a 202 mph top speed with the track-dominating 2026 Ford Mustang® GTD." The same rating applied from launch: Carscoops, September 16, 2024, "The supercharged 5.2-liter V8 engine is now officially rated at 815 hp (608 kW / 826 PS) and 664 lb-ft (900 Nm) of torque" (source carscoops-gtd-815hp-2024). Car and Driver's road-test panel for the 2025 car agrees: "Power: 815 hp @ 7400 rpm" (cd-mustang-gtd-2025).

weightLb.note: Weight-order step 2: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision, 9 October 2026, docs/DATA_GUIDE.md); a measured weight of C/D's test car. Car and Driver road-test panel '2025 Ford Mustang GTD' (owner copy), quote: "Curb Weight: 4404 lb". Test car: "front-engine, rear-wheel-drive, 2-passenger, 2-door coupe", "8-speed dual-clutch automatic" (the only transmission), "Base/As Tested: $327,960/$367,960", "Options: Performance package, $40,000", so it is not a base car. Earlier provisional figure: Ford's "base curb weight of approximately 4,340 lbs" (Autoweek, Wesley Wren, 21 February 2025), 1.5% lower; the same article reports an EPA certification figure of 4,343 lb; MotorTrend weighed an optioned car at 4,411 lb. See discrepancies.
